scope: Actual independent Chromium targets at 688 CSS pixels, normal motion then prefers-reduced-motion:reduce, for all 38 animated course SVG files. Each has normal animations, zero reduced animations, identical visible text styling, and text bounds inside viewBox. Screenshots were captured; this check does not claim human visual inspection, semantics, webpage layout, or remote Colab/GPU execution. Files without CSS keyframes are outside this motion check.
